00055 /**
00056  * @brief               Create a scrollbar widget
00057  *
00058  * This function creates a new scrollbar widget.
00059  *
00060  * The fullRange and visibleRange arguments are used by the system to
00061  * calculate a ratio, which is used to determine where to draw the thumb of
00062  * the scrollbar when the user moves the scroll wheel or presses the scroll
00063  * arrow.  fullRange is an arbitrary number representing the total size of
00064  * scrollbable data, while visibleRange is a value proportional to fullRange
00065  * that represents the visible data.
00066  *
00067  * @param id            IN:     Unique ID for the widget, defined by app,
00068  *                              or kHxWidgetAutoID to auto-generate the ID
00069  * @param pParent       IN:     Pointer to "parent" widget containing scrollbar 
00070  * @param attributes    IN:     Attributes defining properties of the
00071  *                              scrollbar, including orientation.
00072  * @param fullRange     IN:     Full range of the scrollbar
00073  * @param visibleRange  IN:     Visible range of the scrollbar
00074  * @param hScrollbar    OUT:    Handle to the created scrollbar, NULL on
00075  *                              failure
00076  *
00077  * @return HxResult:            Returns HX_OK if successful.  Returns
00078  *                              HX_MEMORY_ERROR if memory allocation fails.
00079  *                              Returns HX_INVALID_ARG if fullRange or
00080  *                              visibleRange <= 0.
00081  *
00082  **/
00083 HxResult HxScrollbarNew(uint32_t id, HxWidget_t* pParent, 
00084                 HxScrollbarAttributes_t attributes, int32_t fullRange,
00085                 int32_t visibleRange, HxScrollbar_t** hScrollbar);
00086

00102 HxResult HxScrollbarDelete(HxScrollbar_t* pScrollbar);
